name: Pill toggle
description: An on/off pill, for filters such as vegetarian only.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/pill-toggle", name: "Pill toggle", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "An on/off pill, for filters such as vegetarian only.",
  states: [BoolState(name: "on", default: false)],
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    Box(padding: Insets(x: 14, y: 8), radius: Radius.full, background: state.on ? Color.primary : Color.surface, border: Border(width: 1, color: state.on ? Color.primary : Color.border), onTap: Toggle(state: "on"), ariaLabel: "Vegetarian only", child: Row(gap: Space.xs, mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center, children: [Icon(name: state.on ? Icons.check : Icons.plus, size: Size.sm, color: state.on ? Color.primaryInk : Color.text), Text(child: "Vegetarian only", weight: FontWeight.medium, color: state.on ? Color.primaryInk : Color.text)]))
  )],
)
